repugnant, eh wot?
Perhaps an octopus-ink

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The fin of the {ff 00 00 07}hammerhead
shark{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} is used in some

delightful delicacy called
shark's-fin soup!
{07 00 00}This dish is usually{01 00 00 0a 00} quite

the dried shark's fin!
{07 0e 00}After THAT,{01 00 00 05 00} the chef must
pick out the skin and
cartilage with tweezers!
Only after all that can it
be used as an ingredient.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 16 00}THAT is a just cost!
